title: Visual metacognition — system must know when its own visual evidence is unreliable
description: IABV must detect when its own visual capture is unreliable (black image, offscreen window, low information) and NOT treat it as valid evidence. This is a metacognition capability: the system observes its own observation and classifies it.
resume_hint: P0.3 implements the first real case: ChatGPT window offscreen (rect=[-32000,-32000,199,34]) producing blank capture (blank_probability=0.98). _window_rect_is_captureable and _capture_is_low_information now classify this. _validate_visual_evidence_result prevents false success.
next_action: Extend visual metacognition to cover: partial occlusion, wrong window captured, resolution too low for meaningful content. Validate with more live scenarios.

real_failure_case.root_cause: ControlCenterViewModel accepted offscreen/minimized window as valid target and captured black image as evidence

metadata.p03_fix: _window_rect_is_captureable() rejects rect with left/top <= -30000. _capture_is_low_information() rejects blank_probability >= 0.90. _validate_visual_evidence_result() sets status=visual_unresolved instead of visual_captured. Runtime audit traces visual_evidence_snapshot with status=unresolved.
metadata.unresolved: Only offscreen/minimized and blank capture are detected. More visual metacognition scenarios need implementation.
